title: the mouths of the lions

verses.text: My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, for I was found innocent in His sight, and I have done no wrong against you, O king.”

caption:
Daniel prayed with the window open, knowing exactly what it would cost him.

The law was signed and the den was real, and he went to his knees anyway. Rescue did not spare him the night among the lions. It met him inside it, and by morning the mouths that should have opened stayed shut.

Daniel 6:22 (BSB)
